# Security Deposits Held and Renegotiated Payment Arrangement Schedules — Basis Q&A

**Rule.** When the installment schedule of an active Payment Arrangement plan is renegotiated, the deposit months are 2 when a Security Deposit in held status on the service agreement holds at least $300.00, 1 when a held deposit holds more than zero but less than $300.00, and zero when no deposit is held on the agreement.

## Questions the rule answers

**Which deposit is read?**
The Security Deposit recorded on the same service agreement as the plan, in held status, and the amount it holds.

**What applies when the held deposit holds exactly $300.00?**
2 months — at least $300.00.

**What applies when it holds $299.99?**
1 month — more than zero and less than $300.00.

**What applies when the deposit on the agreement has been assessed but is not yet held, or has been refunded?**
Zero — no deposit is held on the agreement.

| Held deposit amount (hypothetical) | None held | $75.00 | $299.99 | $300.00 | $640.00 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Deposit months | 0 | 1 | 1 | 2 | 2 |
